command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ps=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); `$ns=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); foreach(`$p in `$ps){ foreach(`$n in `$ns){ `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration'; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u).output; `$m=`$o -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match 'ip route-static 150\.0\.0\.1|ip route-static 160\.0\.0\.1|static-lsp|isis cost'}; if(`$m){Write-Output ('PROJECT='+`$p+' NODE='+`$n); `$m} } }"
